proposal.summary: Vulnerability in the CLI of Cisco Secure Email Gateway could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands.
proposal.cwe_quote: This vulnerability is due to improper input validation in the CLI.

AV.quote: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by injecting operating system commands into a legitimate command.

PR.quote: To successfully exploit this vulnerability, an attacker would need valid Administrator credentials.

C.quote: A successful exploit could allow the attacker to escape the restricted command prompt and execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the input validation mechanisms in the CLI and apply necessary patches or updates.
